metadata.description: Small, focused Claude Code plugins for day-to-day development workflows.

plugins.name: docker-npm
plugins.description: Run npm/pnpm/yarn/bun operations inside a project's Docker container and keep the host node_modules in sync for the IDE.

plugins.name: session-tracking
plugins.description: Open and close work sessions: load project context, write a per-session resume, and keep time-tracking tables up to date.

plugins.name: conventions-guard
plugins.description: Hooks enforcing conventions as Claude writes: braces on control statements, 500-line limit on Node/TS files, no secrets in committed files.

plugins.name: personas
plugins.description: Switch Claude into an expert persona with /persona (CTO, web designer, DBA...). Global personas are completed, not replaced, by per-project files.
